description: Returns the absolute value of the argument.

version.content: If exprn evaluates to SFalse, SFalse is returned.
If exprn evaluates to bottom, bottom is returned.

type: Constants, variables, other triggers, functions, or operators
parameter.description:
Specifies the value for which you want to calculate the absolute value.
Return Type: Returns the same type (integer or floating-point) as the result of the expression given as the argument.

code_sample.title: Calculate the X-coordinate distance between the player and a nearby enemy player.
code_sample.description: Used when you want to determine the distance from a specific coordinate or position. By ignoring the direction (left/right, up/down) and taking the absolute value of the difference, the distance is obtained.

code_sample.title: Generating a triangle wave
code_sample.description: Creates a triangle wave-like pattern that changes as 15 -> 0 -> 15. It can be used for smooth, periodic animations or effects (blinking, vibration, color changes, etc.).
